subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Should Kova diagnose OpenClaw through a new focused prepack profile, and if so which release-critical build/package steps must remain mandatory?
rationale: The request adds a packaging mode whose acceptable omissions and ownership boundary cannot be inferred from the issue or adjacent performance work.

options.title: Specify an upstream-compatible profile
options.body: Define the required outputs and allowed omissions, then implement a Kova invocation that validates the profile against a release-shaped OpenClaw runtime.

options.title: Keep the full prepack path
options.body: Retain current release-shaped packaging diagnostics and pursue only Kova-side measurement reductions such as sampler/report optimizations.

recommendation.title: Specify an upstream-compatible profile
recommendation.body: Define the required outputs and allowed omissions, then implement a Kova invocation that validates the profile against a release-shaped OpenClaw runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related performance work and the current assignment make this the strongest available routing candidate.
